omissions.mesh: All seven native mesh/mmesh.nc files remain in the original D-drive study. Rebuild with the included case model, mmesh.ctr and stage5_native_worker.py mesh action.
omissions.runtime: The historical OCI/chroot image, compiler, MPI installation and transient caches are external. Executable hashes and FIREFLY adapter patch accompany the archive.
omissions.compact: Compact mode stores every production raw native heat NC, all 46 ring tables and receipts. Stage 4 arrays, raw parquet and most intermediate mesh diagnostics are in the full bundle with the same inventory_sha256.
